company: NimbusMart Retail Pvt. Ltd. (fictional sample company)

processes.name: Online Order Processing
processes.description: Accepting and confirming customer orders on the website and mobile app.

processes.name: Payment Processing
processes.description: Authorising card, UPI and wallet payments through the payment gateway.

processes.name: Customer Support
processes.description: Handling customer queries by phone, chat and email.

processes.name: Inventory Management
processes.description: Tracking stock levels across warehouses and updating availability online.

processes.name: Payroll Processing
processes.description: Monthly salary calculation and bank transfers for employees.

processes.name: Email and Communication
processes.description: Corporate email, chat and video conferencing.

processes.name: Warehouse Dispatch
processes.description: Picking, packing and handing over orders to courier partners.

processes.name: Marketing Campaigns
processes.description: Email, SMS and social media promotions.

processes.name: HR Onboarding
processes.description: Joining formalities and account creation for new employees.

processes.name: Customer Database Management
processes.description: Central database of customer accounts, addresses and order history.

risks.name: Ransomware attack on core servers
risks.description: Malware encrypts application and database servers and demands payment.
risks.mitigation: Offline immutable backups, EDR on all servers, network segmentation.

risks.name: Phishing and credential theft
risks.description: Employees tricked into revealing passwords, leading to account takeover.
risks.mitigation: Multi-factor authentication and quarterly phishing awareness training.

risks.name: DDoS attack on web store
risks.description: Flood of traffic makes the website unavailable to customers.
risks.mitigation: CDN with DDoS protection and rate limiting.

risks.name: Primary database server failure
risks.description: Hardware or disk failure on the main customer database server.
risks.mitigation: Hot standby replica with automatic failover.

risks.name: Payment gateway server crash
risks.description: Integration server between the store and the payment provider stops responding.
risks.mitigation: Secondary payment provider configured for switch-over.

risks.name: Data centre power outage
risks.description: Grid failure longer than UPS battery capacity at the main data centre.
risks.mitigation: UPS plus diesel generator with monthly load test.

risks.name: Warehouse power cut
risks.description: Local power failure stops scanners, conveyors and packing stations.

risks.name: Flooding at main warehouse
risks.description: Monsoon flooding damages stock and blocks access to the warehouse.

risks.name: Earthquake affecting head office
risks.description: Head office becomes unsafe and staff cannot access it.

risks.name: Internet service provider outage
risks.description: Loss of the primary internet link at the head office.
risks.mitigation: Secondary ISP link with automatic failover.

risks.name: Accidental deletion of customer data
risks.description: Administrator runs a wrong command and deletes customer records.
risks.mitigation: Role-based access and point-in-time database recovery.

risks.name: Courier partner service failure
risks.description: Main courier partner suspends pickups due to strikes or system issues.
risks.mitigation: Agreements with two backup courier partners.

risks.name: Marketing tool misconfiguration
risks.description: Wrong audience or offer sent in a promotional campaign.

plans.strategy: Fail over the web store to the standby cloud region.
steps: Declare incident and notify the crisis team
Switch DNS to the standby region
Verify order placement with a test order
Inform customers via status page

plans.strategy: Switch to the secondary payment provider.
steps: Confirm primary gateway failure with provider
Enable secondary provider in admin console
Run a test transaction
Reconcile failed payments after recovery

plans.strategy: Promote the hot standby replica and restore from backup if needed.
steps: Isolate the failed or infected server
Promote the standby replica to primary
Restore missing data from the latest clean backup
Validate data integrity and reconnect applications

plans.strategy: Restore inventory system on backup server; use manual stock sheets meanwhile.
steps: Switch warehouses to manual stock sheets
Restore inventory application on backup server
Re-enter manual records
Sync stock levels with the web store

plans.strategy: Agents work from home using the cloud helpdesk and softphones.
steps: Activate work-from-home roster
Redirect support number to softphones
Post service notice on website

plans.strategy: Use the cloud email backup service and secondary ISP.
steps: Fail over to the secondary ISP link
Enable cloud email continuity service
Notify staff through SMS

plans.strategy: Process salaries from the payroll provider's backup portal.
steps: Export last month's payroll file
Upload to the provider's backup portal
Approve bank transfer manually
